envelope.description: Route task reviews through one daemon owner across session workers

body.title: Route task reviews through one daemon owner across session workers
body.summary: Keep one canonical project/review-id admission and execution owner in src/daemon/task-review-rpc.ts; connect worker/session/direct paths through existing trusted main-services/router facilities. Add minimal story cleanup admission fence reusable by t3. Preserve actual trusted controller connection lifetimes, independent daemon ownership, serial per-review provider calls and existing progress/diagnostic behavior. No thread subsystem, worker-local coordinator copies or new persistent leases.
acceptanceChecks: Same-id duplicate start/resume across two sessions and worker/direct routes returns already-running before duplicate provider/writer work.
Different ids may overlap native execution without global review queue; all per-review provider calls remain serial and CR publication merges through existing lifecycle owner.
Controller disconnect fences late exchanges and explicit resume skips durable tasks; daemon observer disconnect does not cancel admitted work.
Story admission/cleanup fence accounts for in-flight admission and publication, not only active assessment; release guaranteed after failures.

tests.name: Cross-session and worker/direct duplicate review-id admission starts exactly one execution
Different review ids overlap with serial per-review provider calls and merged CR history
Daemon observer disconnect survives; controller disconnect fences late results and explicit resume skips durable tasks
